subject: Renewal priority list + exec escalation items for upcoming customer reviews
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Prep: Stratus renewal triage + items for exec attention

Team —

Per our Q4 cadence I pulled the renewal heatmap and a short list of accounts that need exec-level attention ahead of our customer reviews. Stratus sits in the red-yellow boundary: high spend but multiple active SLAs and two P1 incidents in the last 90 days. I attached the renewal_priority_heatmap_v1.xlsx and a one-pager with recommended interventions.

Asks:
- Can Product ops confirm whether the latest latency patch has been rolled to the Stratus cluster (dylan)?
- Sales should confirm net-new usage commitments and expansion signal from Hannah/Tom (marissa).
- Finance to propose an updated credit range for incident history (markus).

I propose we escalate the following for exec attention in Friday's leadership sync:
1) Stratus Analytics — request short-term credit + dedicated SLA review
2) OmniRetail (FYI: separate thread)
3) NovaHealth — renewal negotiation risk tied to data residency (not in this thread)

I'll consolidate notes into the one-pager by Wednesday.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: renewal_priority_heatmap_v1.xlsx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prep: Stratus renewal triage + items for exec attention

On 9/28/26 09:12, Marissa Cole wrote:
> Team —
>
> Per our Q4 cadence I pulled the renewal heatmap...

FYI the latency patch (v2.14.3) was rolled to the dedicated pool for Stratus last night at 02:15 UTC. We validated on the canary and saw tail-latency drop ~35% for 99th percentile on the model endpoint they use. Logs show two post-deploy restarts but both recovered automatically.

Open items for infra:
- Confirm whether Stratus uses our shared KV caching (they have a custom prefixing rule) — this affects cost estimates for proposed credits.
- We should export container-level traces for the two P1 incidents and attach to the one-pager (I can produce by Wednesday EOD).

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Director, Serving Reliability

Attachment: (will add traces)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-29T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prep: Stratus renewal triage + items for exec attention

Thanks — clear and helpful. Laura, can you draft the exec one-pager based on Marissa's heatmap + Dylan's traces? Keep it to one page with top-line ask and three supporting bullets: technical state, commercial proposal, and timeline. I want something we can read in under 2 minutes.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Sales Operations

P.S. Finance: I expect a preliminary credit range by Thu so we can push to Procurement before their internal approval window closes on the 8th.
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prep: Stratus renewal triage + items for exec attention

Draft attached — exec_attention_one-pager.pdf. Highlights:
- Health: Moderate risk — system incidents concentrated in 60–90 day window; recent patch improved tail latency but not yet validated in production traffic mix.
- Commercial ask: propose 8–12% one-time credit tied to SLA remediation milestones, plus a 90-day observability pilot (no charge).
- Exec ask: CTO-level sign-off required on remediation timeline; CFO needs credits approval.

I also included a short recommended script for Marissa to use in the GTM review with Hannah/Tom (2 sentences + next meeting request).

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success Operations

Attachment: exec_attention_one-pager.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah@stratus-analytics.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@stratus-analytics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Quick sync to align on renewal outcomes and remediation plan

Hannah / Tom —

Thanks for the ongoing partnership. We're preparing for the upcoming renewal and want to surface a short remediation plan we think will reduce risk and keep your SLA targets in range. Can we set a 30-minute alignment this week? Suggested times: Thu 10/2 10:00am PT or Fri 10/3 9:30am PT.

High-level proposal (preview):
- One-time credit to address recent incidents (range proposal attached).
- Dedicated observability pilot for 90 days to give your engineers live telemetry into vendor-side traces.
- Commitment to a two-week targeted latency validation window post-deploy.

We aim to make the conversation factual and short — Laura will share the one-pager.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: proposed_credits_table.csv
From: Hannah Li <hannah@stratus-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@stratus-analytics.com>, Procurement <procurement@stratus-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Quick sync to align on renewal outcomes and remediation plan

Marissa —

Thanks for the transparency and the one-pager. We can take Fri 10/3 9:30am PT. A couple quick notes before then:
- Procurement will need formal justification for credits, please include incident timelines and any compensating SLAs in the doc.
- Our CTO would like a 15-minute technical deep-dive immediately following the commercial alignment — can Dylan or an SRE join?
- We will need proposed contract language for the 90-day pilot (NDA / data processing terms), send a redline if possible.

We'll be prepared to discuss target usage and rollout cadence.

-Hannah
Hannah Li
Senior Product Ops, Stratus Analytics
